research_question.note: what the paper sets out to answer; cite the sentence, not the field label

data.note: dataset / corpus / cohort / sample size, with version when stated

method_conditions.note: conditions under which the method holds: settings, parameters, environment

main_findings.note: the result the paper claims, with the number that carries it

limitations.note: the precondition under which the finding can fail; not a generic caveat
